title: Simplified Character Evidence Pipeline V3 Schemas
description: Target machine contracts for model-visible payloads, code-only orchestration envelopes, grounded appearance evidence, and bounded cross-Chunk character identity resolution.

SourceSpan.description: Half-open Unicode code-point interval [start, end). Runtime validation must additionally enforce start < end and containment in the declared text container.

PromotedDescribeCharacterRef.description: Formal Chunk-local character created from remaining describe evidence after exact attribution arbitration.

M1MentionDiscoveryInput.description: Actual model-visible M1 payload. Source and Chunk metadata remain in M1OrchestrationEnvelope.

M1OrchestrationEnvelope.description: Code-only M1 envelope; only model_input is sent to the model.

M1MentionDiscoveryResult.description: Actual model output. Code binds it to the M1 orchestration envelope; the model never returns chunk_id.

M2GroundedBelongsToFact.description: Code-hydrated affirmative M2 fact after fact_quote is safely and uniquely bound to an allowed evidence occurrence.

M2ModelBelongsToFact.description: Minimal affirmative appearance fact returned by M2. fact_quote must be a verbatim substring of one allowed evidence quote; code binds its source and span after the model call.

M2CandidateAppearanceParsingInput.description: Actual model-visible M2 payload. It contains one exact target, all currently available individual describe evidence, and Chunk text. It contains no refs, spans, statuses, source IDs, hashes, cache keys, or run metadata.

M2CandidateAppearanceParsingResult.description: Actual model output. It contains only affirmative appearance facts that belong to the current exact target. Code grounds fact_quote, hydrates source refs/spans, merges unique facts into the target, and consumes uniquely bound describe occurrences.

M2OrchestrationEnvelope.description: Code-only M2 envelope. Only model_input is sent to the Provider.

M2GroundedCandidateAppearanceParsingResu.description: Code-hydrated affirmative M2 result passed to N3 after quote binding. Absent model facts remain unclaimed in the describe work pool; code does not synthesize not_target or uncertain assessments.

M2RemainingDescribePromotionInput.description: Actual model-visible payload for creating one or more independent characters from one remaining describe pool. No refs or spans are model-visible.

M2RemainingDescribePromotionResult.description: Actual model output. One remaining describe pool may yield multiple independent characters.

M2RemainingDescribePromotionEnvelope.description: Code-only envelope for remaining-describe character promotion. Only model_input is sent to the Provider.

M2GroundedPromotedDescribeCharactersResu.description: Code-hydrated one-to-many promoted character result using fact-level partial acceptance: uniquely grounded facts are retained, ambiguous facts remain unassigned for review, and cross-character overlap still fails closed. Review issues remain in service trace and are not model-visible.

unassigned_fragments.description: Residual source spans not claimed by any promoted character; preserved for review rather than silently discarded.
